final: WITH patient_measures AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) as m1, AVG(l.APPT - l.PT) as m2 FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX != '' GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_stats AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(m1) as avg_m1, AVG(m2) as avg_m2 FROM patient_measures GROUP BY SEX), global_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_m2) as global_avg_m2 FROM sex_stats), kept_rows AS (SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_m1, s.avg_m2, g.global_avg_m2 FROM sex_stats s CROSS JOIN global_avg g WHERE s.avg_m2 > g.global_avg_m2) SELECT AVG(avg_m2), AVG(avg_m2 - global_avg_m2), AVG(avg_m1) FROM kept_rows
